slides.headline: Spooktacular Miami City Cemetery Walking Tour, Oct. 30
slides.body: Starts at 5 p.m. at Miami City Cemetery, 1800 NE Second Ave., Miami. Tickets are $35 for adults and $15 for kids 14 and under. It puts a local history tour on Halloween weekend.

photo.query: Miami City Cemetery historic graves Miami
photo.prompt: A moody historic cemetery in Miami at dusk with old headstones and people carrying flashlights

slides.headline: Rosa Obscura at Rosa Sky Rooftop, Oct. 30 to 31
slides.body: The rooftop party runs Oct. 30 and 31 at 115 SW Eighth St., 22nd Floor, Miami. Expect DJs, costume looks and Halloween cocktails.

slides.headline: Red Bull Flugtag at Bayfront Park, Oct. 31
slides.body: The free event runs from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Bayfront Park, Miami, with the site opening at 10 a.m. It brings homemade flying machines to the water.

slides.headline: DC Pie Co. Halloween and Dom's Trick or Tequila, Oct. 31
slides.body: DC Pie Co. at 1010 Brickell Ave. in Miami opens noon to 11 p.m. Dom's starts at 5 p.m. and goes late. Kids in costume get a free personal pizza with purchase, and Dom's adds a costume contest and tequila specials.

slides.headline: Day of the Dead at CityPlace Doral, Nov. 1
slides.body: The fifth-annual celebration starts at 4 p.m. at CityPlace Doral, 8300 NW 36th St., Doral. Entry is free with RSVP, and the event includes folkloric dancers, stilt walkers and mariachis.

slides.headline: The Rocky Horror Picture Show at Miami Beach Bandshell, Nov. 1
slides.body: The screening starts at 7 p.m. at Miami Beach Bandshell, 7275 Collins Ave., Miami Beach. Tickets cost $35, and the night includes drag performances, a live shadowcast and a costume contest.
